title: O'Rourke's Peak Cellars
gap: Price for Premium Seated Tasting Experience not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy a Premium Seated Tasting Experience, an intimate hour-long guided tasting of four estate-grown wines plus a bonus pour, with views of the vineyard and lake. The tasting is led by experienced wine educators and explores winemaking philosophy, vineyard practices, and sustainability. Guests may enhance their tasting with a locally inspired BC Cheese & Charcuterie Board pairing.
